versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "会计科目表速查：企业准则vs小企业准则对照+三表勾稽" (v1.0.0).
- Provides quick reference for account code lookup, comparison between enterprise and small enterprise accounting standards, and pre-report reconciliation.
- Includes bidirectional mapping for 156 enterprise and 66 small enterprise account items, major code differences, and list of reconciliation formulas (三表勾稽).
- Lists exclusive enterprise standard items and guides on code remapping.
- Outlines a recommended monthly closing checklist.
- Free, ready-to-use version; also includes info on an extended paid version for full workflows.
